answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the forge queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The crystal index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1641 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the saffron. Each impostor pays 15 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
